_comment: MAINNET GENESIS TEMPLATE. Every address below is an unfilled placeholder and the node WILL REFUSE TO START until each is replaced (config.go::SafetyCheck rejects any address matching the template placeholder shape under a non-localnet profile). Replace all bucket recipients and all five multisigSigners with real, distinct addresses. NOTE: the canoLiq section of this file is not part of Canopy's own genesis schema, so it must be merged into the genesis.json the node actually boots from, or reached via canoliq-config.mainnet.json::genesisPath; a Canopy genesis with no 'buckets' key causes the plugin to fall back to whatever genesisPath points at.

buckets.name: DAO Treasury (canoLiq)
buckets._comment: Credits the protocol-owned treasury_cplq scalar, not an address. This is what funds SPEND_CPLQ treasury spends, the buyback, and ProposalOTCProgramFund.

params._comment: 3-of-5 multisig. All five signers must be distinct wallets held by five different people; ValidateParams rejects duplicates because countMultisigApprovals would otherwise let one holder cast two of the three required approvals. treasuryThreshold is in uCNPY.

_validatorRegistryComment: Seed with the real Canopy validator addresses of the launch operators (5-10). Shipping this empty routes the entire 15% validator-incentive slice to the synthetic all-0xCA aggregator key, which nobody can spend from. The registry is reconciled against live committee membership every block, so these must be genuine validator addresses.
